description: Corpus-aligned self-labeled query set for the live .254 aimee doc corpus (2966 docs, all embedded). Every expected doc exists + has an embedding, so this exercises the doc fusion path (FTS lexical + dense) with no dependency on the deep-curator synthesis. positive = identifier/exact-token queries where dynamic_alpha's high-alpha lexical boost should help; false_positive_guard = prose queries where dynamic must not regress the dense leg.
